unlisted_practices: Congress should reject any legislation introducing AI-enabled autonomous prescribing unless it is accompanied by empowered, well-resourced regulatory oversight.
Regulators should rigorously regulate and continuously monitor AI systems entrusted with high-stakes medical decisions.

Restrict autonomous AI prescribing authority, at least in the near term, to specific circumstances such as particular patient populations, disease types, urgent situations, or pre-defined medication categories.
Ensure at least system-level (helicopter-level) human oversight supported by appropriate digital monitoring technologies for autonomous medical AI systems.
Maintain strong, well-resourced regulatory agencies with AI expertise capable of developing and testing regulatory frameworks for medical AI.

screen.reason: Commentary on US regulatory policy and congressional proposals regarding autonomous AI prescribing and FDA oversight.
